justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent initially asked for clarification on "next Monday" despite the user providing a specific time, but then correctly interpreted subsequent date and time requests.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent repeatedly reported unavailability without offering alternative slots or proactively suggesting different dates or times, forcing the user to drive the negotiation.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent repeated the same unavailable slots and did not offer any alternatives, leading to a repetitive and inefficient conversation where the user had to continuously suggest new times.
justifications.customer_experience: The customer experience was frustrating due to the agent's inability to offer alternative slots and its repetitive responses, making the user do all the work in finding an appointment.
